working_definition: Ovary-like cells appearing in non-ovary analyses (oenocyte, body wall); Manual Annotation, broad class female reproductive system. An organ-level remainder group.
justification: No generic 'ovary cell' term exists in FBbt; available ovary cell terms are specific (somatic cell of ovariole, ovarian sheath cell, germline types) and none covers the general ovary cell group.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Somatic cell that is part of the ovariole. This does not include the ovarian sheath.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Excludes germline and sheath cells; narrower than 'ovary cell'.
